Best PRP treatment in Rajkot.

Restore youthful skin, stimulate healthy hair growth, and enhance your natural beauty using safe, advanced, and scientifically proven Platelet-Rich Plasma therapy.

At Advanced Skin Clinic Rajkot, our expert dermatologists utilize state-of-the-art Platelet-Rich Plasma (PRP) therapy to deliver natural-looking, long-lasting results for both skin rejuvenation and hair restoration.

Why choose PRP treatment?

Safe & non-surgical — one of the biggest advantages of PRP treatment is that it uses your body's own healing components.

  • Minimally invasive procedure
  • No harsh chemicals involved
  • Minimal downtime
  • Low risk of allergic reactions
  • Quick recovery
  • Natural-looking results

PRP therapy is an innovative regenerative treatment that harnesses the healing power of your body's own blood. A small sample of blood is collected and processed to concentrate platelets rich in growth factors, which are then carefully injected into targeted areas of the skin or scalp to promote natural healing and tissue regeneration.

Benefits on hair

PRP for hair regrowth is highly effective for individuals experiencing hair thinning, androgenic alopecia, and early-stage hair loss.

  • Stimulation of dormant hair follicles
  • Reduction in hair fall and thinning
  • Improved hair density and thickness
  • Enhanced scalp health
  • Natural hair growth without surgery
  • Long-lasting hair restoration support

Benefits on skin

PRP skin rejuvenation stimulates collagen production and cellular repair, helping your skin appear healthier, smoother, and more youthful.

  • Improved skin texture and tone
  • Reduction in fine lines and wrinkles
  • Enhanced collagen production
  • Increased skin firmness and elasticity
  • Natural glow and radiance
  • Reduction in acne scars and pigmentation concerns
